metadata.title: Input Validation and Error Handling Framework

story.iWant: consistent error handling and validation across all customer APIs
story.soThat: clients receive clear, actionable error messages
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create global @ControllerAdvice exception handler (AC: #1, #5, #6) - Task 2: Create standard error response DTOs (AC: #1, #2, #5) - Task 3: Create custom exception classes (AC: #5) - Task 4: Implement field-level validation annotations (AC: #3, #7) - Task 5: Implement custom validators for complex rules (AC: #8) - Task 6: Test all error scenarios and status codes (AC: #4, #5)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Global exception handler (@ControllerAdvice) created for all endpoints 2. Validation errors return structured response with field-level error details 3. Field-level validation rules: firstName/lastName (required, 1-100), email (required, valid format, unique), phone (optional, valid format), dateOfBirth (optional, age >= 18), zipCode (optional, valid format) 4. Business logic validation: Cannot create customer with duplicate email, Cannot update customer to INACTIVE if referenced by active entities 5. HTTP status codes used correctly: 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 500 Internal Server Error 6. Error response includes traceId (correlation ID) 7. Validation annotations (@NotNull, @Email, @Pattern) used in entity 8. Custom validators for complex rules (age validation, phone format)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR012: Request/response payload validation with clear, field-level error messaging. Provide actionable error messages for client developers.

doc.title: Story 1.2: Spring Boot Core Configuration
doc.snippet: Story 1.2 established basic GlobalExceptionHandler. Story 2.7 extends it with comprehensive validation error handling and field-level error details.

artifact.reason: Extend existing exception handler with all validation error handlers, field-level error extraction, and traceId inclusion.

story-context.constraints: - Centralized error handling: All exceptions handled in @ControllerAdvice - Field-level error details: Extract from BindingResult for validation errors - TraceId inclusion: Extract from MDC (X-Trace-Id header from Story 1.4) - Standard error response format: ErrorDetails + FieldError + metadata - HTTP status codes strictly followed: 400 validation, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 500 server error - Custom validators: AgeValidator (age >= 18), PhoneValidator (international format) - Story 2.2-2.6 context: All CRUD operations use validation framework

tests.standards: Testing standards require comprehensive error scenario tests for all validation rules, custom validators, and HTTP status code correctness.
tests.ideas: AC1: Test GlobalExceptionHandler handles all exception types with correct status codes AC2: Test MethodArgumentNotValidException returns 400 with field-level error details AC3: Test field validation: firstName required (400 if null), email format (400 if invalid), phone format (400 if invalid pattern), age validation (400 if < 18) AC4: Test business validation: duplicate email returns 409 Conflict AC5: Test HTTP status codes: 200 OK (success), 201 Created (create), 400 Bad Request (validation), 404 Not Found (resource missing), 409 Conflict (duplicate/state conflict), 500 Internal Server Error (unexpected) AC6: Test error response includes traceId extracted from MDC AC7: Test validation annotations work on Customer entity: @NotNull, @Email, @Pattern AC8: Test custom validators: AgeValidator (age >= 18), PhoneValidator (international format regex)
